mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are enjoying fair conditions and a comfortable 70 degrees near Harriet Park. Tonight at 5:50 PM, clear skies will offer a great view of the International Space Station for 3 minutes as it rises in the northwest over Middleton near Verona High School and travels low toward Fitchburg.

In city news, Verona has shared holiday operational changes. City offices and the recycling center will close on Thursday, November 26, and Friday, November 27, for Thanksgiving, shifting Thursday trash collection to Friday. Meanwhile, Public Works is evaluating space needs for a modern facility to support community growth.

Looking at community happenings, you can attend Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you have several trivia options, including Hop Haus Brewing, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's.
In the police recap, on Monday, November 9, an officer pulled over a swerving vehicle on Highway 18 151. The 61-year-old driver was arrested for an O W I third offence and cited for open intoxicants.
Wrapping things up, Culvers of Verona is open until 10 PM today, featuring Butter Pecan as today's flavor of the day.
